## Feature Summary

Provide a concise description of the feature or enhancement being proposed.

## Problem Statement

Describe the problem this feature solves. What limitation or gap in the current system does it address?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution in detail. Include:

- Which component(s) it affects (n8n, Supabase, Statamic, Claude)
- The expected data flow or workflow logic
- Any new API integrations required

## Phase Alignment

Which project phase does this feature belong to or extend?

- [ ] Phase 0: Intelligence Indexer
- [ ] Phase 1: Structural & H1 Audit
- [ ] Phase 2: Meta & Content Optimizer
- [ ] New Phase (describe below)

## Safety Considerations

Does this feature involve writing data back to Statamic? If yes:

- [ ] Slug Guard has been considered and will be implemented
- [ ] Drift Check (Pre/Post Verification) will be implemented
- [ ] Select Field writeback will use raw string keys only
- [ ] Bard Field manipulation will preserve ProseMirror JSON

## Success Criteria

How will we know this feature is working correctly? Define measurable outcomes.

## Additional Context

Add any mockups, references, or supporting documentation here.
